text.tspan: ). Sampling is one argument away, for when varied answers matter more
than the single most likely one.
Varied answers without nonsense: the temperature controls how adventurous the draw is, and top-k guarantees that only the model’s
best candidates can ever be written. Greedy is untouched —
sequence A — "the dog sat on the floor" (padded by
